propositions: rebar search returns full ticket bodies with descriptions and all comments, consuming excessive context (~203 KB for typical discovery queries)
there is no durable summary field in the event/state schema; discovery summary must be derived from description and truncated to 240 characters
search command lacks --output flag support; --output json/llm should validate against distinct schemas while --full returns legacy TicketState shape
snippet extraction must locate and preserve matched terms case-insensitively within a bounded 240-character window from description, comments, tags, or identifiers without returning full bodies
predicate-only and negation-only queries return null snippet; positive free-text queries return bounded case-preserving context windows centered on the first matching term
default search output must drop full description and comment bodies, enforce 25,000-byte ceiling on typical queries, and support both summary-first JSON and minified LLM output modes
